card.name: Words just before 'participate' ideas
card.fires_on: Small words and short phrases where the next word could plausibly be about taking part or participants, such as 'optional', 'those who', 'all', 'in order that', 'sixty per cent of the'. It fires on the word before the slot, not on 'participation' itself.

modes.label: Voluntary or group membership
modes.description: Words describing who joins in or whether joining is required, like 'optional' or 'those who'.

modes.label: Linking words before a group
modes.description: Determiners and connectors before a group of people, such as 'every' or 'the' before an electorate.
modes.example: Sixty per cent of<< the>> Quebec electorate voted against it.

modes.label: Before an invitation to join
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words that lead into a call to take part or sign up.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning participation, participants and taking part, and away from unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on small words where the text is about to say who takes part or whether people join in.
